entries.name: Elemental Mastery

desc.1: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of Lightning Bolt by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from Chain Lightning. Lasts 15 sec.

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Elemental Mastery renamed Lightning Mastery, all references to Lava Burst removed; it needs Call of Thunder in Lava Burst's place (guessed); the new icon isn't named

entries.name: Stormstrike

desc.1: Instantly strike for 100% normalized weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

fields.cost: 8% base Mana; Melee Range; Instant; 8 sec cooldown

entries.source: Blizzard class tuning 2026-11-10 (hotfix article 24315281): 100% normalized weapon damage, 8 sec cooldown (the Nov 2 notes had 150%, 6 sec)

entries.name: Maelstrom Weapon

desc.1: When you deal melee damage, you have a chance (6 procs per minute, based on your main hand weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.2: When you deal melee damage, you have a chance (7 procs per minute, based on your main hand weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.3: When you deal melee damage, you have a chance (8 procs per minute, based on your main hand weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.4: When you deal melee damage, you have a chance (9 procs per minute, based on your main hand weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
desc.5: When you deal melee damage, you have a chance (10 procs per minute, based on your main hand weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

entries.source: Blizzard class tuning 2026-11-10 (hotfix article 24315281): 20% a stack at every rank, (5 + rank) procs per minute on main hand speed

entries.name: Riptide

desc.1: Heals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

fields.cost: 147 Mana; 40 yd range; Instant; 12 sec cooldown

entries.source: development notes 2026-11-02 (post 9): Riptide has no instant heal, a 12 sec cooldown (was 6) and about 40% less mana (245 x 0.6 = 147); clients 70753 and 70755 unchanged (orchestration/round_70753/shaman.md)

entries.name: Mana Tide Totem

desc.1: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 13 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

entries.source: Forever client totem duration: every rank of Mana Tide Totem lasts 13 sec since client 70338 (Classic 12); the generated tooltip reads 12 (shaman_audit.md 7.1, core.ManaTideTotemDuration)
